warning.titlePre: Mercedes Vario Injector Seal & Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: Vario 508D/510D engines - OM602 and OM611, across the entire production run - commonly show injector seal and timing chain/gear wear over time. We replace timing chain components, timing gears, injector seals, and gaskets as standard on every Vario 508D/510D rebuild.
